d: If your account has been inactive for 24 consecutive months, the exchange treats it as inactive, which prevents you from placing trades or participating in buybacks, OFS, or rights issues. By logging into account.zerodha.com with your Kite credentials and completing the Re-KYC process, you can easily update your segments, contact details, profile information, and complete the In-Person Verification (IPV) to restore your account.
